  obtain ⟨q,w,h,M,hspace,c,k,hc,runhyp⟩ := hA
  let P := TM.ofMachine M
  let es := @TM.number (TM.PS (Fin (q+1))) _ _
  let ew := Fintype.equivFin (Fin w ⊕ Fin w)
  let eh := Fintype.equivFin (Fin h ⊕ Fin h)
  refine ⟨_, _, _, P.twice.reindex es ew eh, ?_, c*2,k, by positivity, ?_⟩

Take the space constant \(d\) of \(\mathcal M\) and aim for the constant \(2d\).

    refine ⟨d*2, by omega, fun x coins t => ?_⟩

have space (coins : CoinTape) (t : ℕ) :
        P.spaceThrough x coins t ≤ d * Nat.clog 2 (x.length + 2) := by
      rw [← P.space_reindex (.refl _) (.refl _) (.refl _)]
      exact hsp x coins t

children.informal: The two runs together use at most \(2d\lceil\log_2(n+2)\rceil\) cells.

rw [TM.space_reindex]
    refine (P.space_twice x coins t).trans (le_trans (add_le_add (space _ _) (space _ _)) ?_)
    exact le_of_eq (by ring)

      intro coins
      obtain ⟨b,hb⟩ := halt coins
      rw [← P.out_reindex (.refl _) (.refl _) (.refl _)]
      exact ⟨b,hb⟩

children.informal: Let \(k=T(n)\), let \(f_b(t)\) be the configuration at time \(t\) under coin string \(b\in\{0,1\}^k\), and let \(g_t(b)=p_0(f_b(t))\).
For \(t<k\), \(g_t(b)=\tfrac12\bigl(g_{t+1}(b)+g_{t+1}(b')\bigr)\), where \(b'\) is \(b\) with bit \(t\) flipped.
children.header:
have HH (t) (ht : t<k) (b : Tapes k) :
      g t b = (g (t+1) b + g (t+1) (Toggle ⟨t,ht⟩ b))/2 := by

children.informal: Let \(i=t\), let \(b'\) be \(b\) with bit \(i\) flipped, and extend coin strings to infinite coin tapes.
children.code:
let i : Fin k := ⟨t,ht⟩
    let l := Toggle i b
    let w := Machine.extendCoins
       (t:=k)

children.informal: \(f_b(t)=f_{b'}(t)\), since the first \(t\) coins of \(b\) and \(b'\) agree.
children.header: have hv : f b t=f l t := by

children.informal: It suffices that \(b\) and \(b'\) agree at every \(j<t\).
children.code:
apply P.same
      intro j hj

children.informal: Such \(j\) satisfies \(j<k\).
children.code: have hk : j<k := by omega

children.informal: \(i\ne j\).
children.code: have hne : i.val≠j := by dsimp [i]; omega

children.informal: So the positions \(i\) and \(j\) of the coin string differ.
children.code: have hne' : i ≠ ⟨j,hk⟩ := fun h=>hne (congrArg Fin.val h)

children.informal: Hence \(b'(j)=b(j)\).
children.code: simp [Machine.extendCoins, l, Toggle,hk,hne']

children.informal: At time \(t<k\), the configuration under each of \(b,b'\) steps along its coin \(t\) to its time-\((t+1)\) configuration, and the configuration under \(b\) is not a final rewarded one.
children.code:
obtain ⟨hn,Hp⟩ := P.step_true e x (w b) t ht
    obtain ⟨hn',-⟩ := P.step_true e x (w l) t ht

children.informal: Coin \(t\) of \(b\) is \(b(i)\).
children.code: have h1 : w b t=b i := Machine.extendCoins_apply b i

children.informal: Coin \(t\) of \(b'\) is \(\lnot b(i)\).
children.code:
have h2 : w l t= (!b i) :=
      (Machine.extendCoins_apply l i).trans (by simp [l,Toggle])

children.informal: Using \(p_0=e+Sp_0\) at \(f_b(t)\) with \(e=0\) there, \(p_0(f_b(t))\) is the average of \(p_0\) over the two successors \(f_b(t+1)\) and \(f_{b'}(t+1)\).
children.code:
rw [h1] at hn
    rw [h2] at hn'
    change P.next x (f b t) (b i)=some (f b (t+1)) at hn
    change P.next x (f l t) (!b i)=some (f l (t+1)) at hn'
    change P.fin x (f b t)=false at Hp
    rw [← hv] at hn'
    change P.pr x (f b t) = (P.pr x (f b (t+1)) + P.pr x (f l (t+1))) / 2
    rw [pr_eq]
    cases h : b i <;> simp only [h, Bool.not_true,Bool.not_false] at hn hn' <;>
      simp [reward,Hp,avg,payoff,hn,hn',add_comm]

children.informal: For every \(t\le k\), \(\sum_b g_0(b)=\sum_b g_t(b)\), by induction using the averaging identity and the fact that flipping bit \(t\) is a bijection.
children.code:
have hs (t) (ht : t≤k) : ∑ b, g 0 b= ∑ b, g t b := by
    induction t with
    | zero => rfl
    | succ t ih =>
      have hlt : t<k := ht
      rw [ih (by omega)]
      calc
        _ = ∑ b, (g (t+1) b+g (t+1) (Toggle ⟨t,hlt⟩ b))/2 :=
             Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun b _=> HH t hlt b)
        _ = _ := by
          rw [← Finset.sum_div, Finset.sum_add_distrib,Fintype.sum_equiv
             (Toggle ⟨t,hlt⟩) _ (g (t+1)) (fun b=>rfl)]
          ring

let p (b : Tapes k) := P.mach.output (P.mach.run x (Machine.extendCoins b) k).state = some true
  let : DecidablePred p := fun i => inferInstanceAs (Decidable (_ = some true))

children.informal: \(g_k(b)=1\) if \(\mathrm{acc}(b)\) and \(0\) otherwise.
children.code: have hv (b) : g k b = if p b then 1 else 0 := P.pr_end e x _
have hz (b) : g 0 b = P.pr x (P.first x) := rfl

children.informal: \(\sum_b g_0(b)=\sum_b g_k(b)\).
children.code: have he := hs k le_rfl

children.informal: Thus \(2^k p_0(x_0)=\#\{b:\mathrm{acc}(b)\}\), which is \(2^k\) times the acceptance probability.
children.code:
simp only [hz,hv] at he
  rw [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fun, Fintype.card_bool, Fintype.card_fin] at he
  unfold Machine.acceptanceProbability
  rw [eq_div_iff (by positivity),mul_comm]
  change (2:ℚ)^k * P.pr x (P.first x) = _
  rw [Finset.card_filter]
  simpa using he

  apply monotone_nat_of_le_succ; intro t
  induction t with
  | zero=> exact (csr hp h hc 1).nn
  | succ t ih=> exact Fgrow hc hp (fun i=>(h i).1) le_rfl ih

lemma pilot_bounds {S'} (h : SB P.S S' P.f 1 P.C) (k : ℕ) :
    SB P.S S' P.f k (P.pilots n k).E := by
  induction k with
  | zero=> simpa [pilots] using sb0 P.S S' P.f
  | succ k ih=>
    simpa only [probed,pilots,f,update,Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one] using
      Fsb (g:=fun x=> gamma (P.probed n (k+1) x)) (rate_pos _) (fun x=>gamma_mem _)
             (data_bounds h ih (rate_pos _))

lemma cpilot {S'} (h : SB P.S S' P.f 1 P.C) {k : ℕ} (hk:k≤P.p.T) :
    P.corr n k≤ (P.pilots n k).E := by
  induction k with
  | zero => exact le_rfl
  | succ k ih =>
    refine Fgrow h (rate_pos _) (g:=P.gm n P.p.T) (g':=P.gm n (k+1)) (fun _=>(gamma_mem _).1)
                     ?_ (ih (by omega))
    exact fun x=>gamma_anti (P.V_mono n hk x)

lemma sampler_identity (k j : ℕ) (x y : ZMod n) (e : d ≤ w) (z : Salt (w-d)) (l : ℕ)
    (f : Env n w → ℝ) (s : Slice n k j d) :
    sampling k j x y e l f (exportP k j x y e z s) =
       walk (mixP k j) (panel k j x y e z f) l s := by
  induction l generalizing s with
  | zero =>
    simp [sampling,walk,go,live,exportP,panel]
  | succ l ih =>
    let o := exportP k j x y e z
    unfold sampling
    rw [walk,atom_mix,mul_sum,pathFold]
    apply sum_congr rfl; intro a _
    simp_rw [pathFold Roller]
    rw [sum_comm]
    let b := winner k j x y a (o s)
    have he (p : Paths Atom l) (v : Paths Roller l) :
       (if live k j x y e (l:=l+1) (a,p) (b,v) (o s) then
          weight^(l+1) * f (go k j e (l:=l+1) (a,p) (b,v) (o s)) else 0) =
       weight * (if live k j x y e p v (o (fullact k j a s)) then
          weight^l*f (go k j e p v (o (fullact k j a s))) else 0) := by
      have hg : rol k j e a b (o s)=o (fullact k j a s) := winner_roll ..
      rw [live,ite_eq_left rfl,go,Equiv.trans_apply,hg]
      split; rw [pow_succ',mul_assoc]; rw [mul_zero]
    rw [Finset.sum_eq_single b]
    · rw [← ih]
      simp only [sampling, mul_sum]
      exact sum_congr rfl (fun p _ => sum_congr rfl (fun v _=> he p v))
    · intro v _ h
      have hv : v ≠ winner k j x y a (exportP k j x y e z s) := h
      simp [live,hv]
    · simp

lemma winning {s k d D b c} (h : Due s k d D b c f) (hr : 0< s.key.r) (i) :

lemma pre_head (h:r.Good) {i} (hh:i≤r.L) (hp:r.pre i) :
   (r.mid i).base≤r.dust i ∧ ∀ x∈r.S, ht (r.loss i x) ≤ r.dust i := by
   induction i with
   | zero=>simp [mid,dust,ht,loss,pile]
   | succ i ih=>
     obtain ⟨hb,hx⟩:= ih (by omega) (fun j hj=>hp j (by omega))
     have he : (r.pm i).U (r.enter i)≤r.rho i :=
        le_of_not_gt (hp i (Nat.lt_add_one _))
     rw [r.dust_next]
     constructor
     · rw [r.mid_succ]; change (r.pm i).Z _≤_
       have hp : 0≤r.rho i := (h.pos _ hh).le
       have hh1:= ((r.pm i).Z_w (r.enter i)).2.1
       have hh2:=r.dust_nn h (i:=i) (by omega)
       linarith
     · intro x hi
       have hp := hx x hi
       rw [r.iter_loss]
       apply (ht_add ..).trans
       apply add_le_add hp
       rw [r.mid_succ]
       apply (ht_sub ..).2
       exact near_le (Params.perturb ..) (by linarith)

  | base=>rw [r.steady_zero]

    have ht1:=ih (by omega)
    rw [r.steady_push hi, ← ht1]

induction i,he using Nat.le_induction with
   | base=>rw [r.cloud0]; exact r.hood_init h hL hh hm
   | succ i hi ih=>

     have he1 : i < r.L := by omega
     have h1:=ih he1
     let p:=r.pm i; let u:=r.enter i; let v:=r.steady j i
     have h2:=Params.smooth_push p h1
     have ht0: u.base≤4 := r.base_mid i |>.2
     have ht1: v.base≤4 := r.still_here_c h hi he1.le hp |>.2.1
     rw [tower_push (r.enter_tall h hi he1 hp hh hm).1 hh ht0 p,
         tower_push (r.still_hi h hi he1.le hp hh) hh ht1 p] at h2
     rw [r.steady_push hi]; unfold enter
     rw [r.mid_succ]
     have hn := r.bad_nn i; have hn2 := r.bad_nn (i+1)
     have hb := r.hood_link (i:=i+1) rfl h2
             (show 0≤wideK B*(r.bad i+r.bad (i+1)) from by positivity)
             (fun x hx=> r.hood_prev h hi hL hh hm hx)
     have hz : 30*(wideK B*r.cloud j i)+wideK B*(r.bad i+r.bad (i+1))≤wideK B*r.cloud j (i+1) := by
        rw [r.cloud_step hi]
        nlinarith [mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left (r.cloud_bad hi) hz.le]
     exact ⟨le_trans hb.1 hz,fun x hx=>near_le (hb.2 x hx) hz⟩

    (hp : ∀ i<r.L,kap i=true → 1≤(r.pm i).U (r.shifted i (r.actual R kap i)))

   induction H with

     Ears s (f.cost c) H f.weight (choir p f) V:= by
    induction h generalizing H with
    | @byear s i q v h=> apply supply h hc le_rfl; exact (Nat.le_add_right ..).trans he
    | @played s i f h hl hb=>
      have hp:H ≤ T :=(Nat.le_add_right ..).trans he
      exact ⟨_, Brick.each0 p f i s H h ((Nat.pow_le_pow_right Nat.zero_lt_two hp).trans hl) rfl hb⟩
    | @doo s i j A B u o h h1 h2 h3 ia ib=>
      let z:=pulse i.weight j.weight
      let v:= H+z*s.d
      let k:=max (i.cost c) (j.cost c)
      have hp:v+max (tail i) (tail j)*s.d ≤ T:=by
          change H+(z+max i.tail j.tail)*s.d ≤ T at he
          unfold v; rwa [add_mul,← add_assoc] at he
      have hi : v+(tail i)*s.d ≤ T := by
         apply le_trans _ hp
         gcongr; exact le_max_left ..
      have hj : v+(tail j)*s.d ≤ T:=by
         apply le_trans _ hp
         gcongr; exact le_max_right ..
      apply Bid.joint u.ration h (u.legit ..) ((cost_hi (p:=i) hc).trans (le_max_left ..)) _ _ h3
      · exact supply (ia hi) (cost_hi hc) (le_max_left ..) le_rfl
      exact supply (ib hj) (cost_hi hc) (le_max_right ..) le_rfl
    | @little s q f V b h hz hf ih=>
      let i:= f.weight
      let w:=choir p f
      have hp:q.Trust s i V (f.cost c) (H+(if b then q.reserve else 0)*s.d) w:= by
         refine ⟨hz,fun j hj=>ih j hj ?_⟩
         unfold tail at he; dsimp only [Branch.port]; rwa [add_mul,← add_assoc] at he
      cases b
      · simp only [choir,cost,weight,Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false]
        simp only [Bool.false_eq_true,ite_false,zero_mul,add_zero] at hp
        exact q.lease hp (cost_hi hc) h.1
      simp only [choir,cost,weight,ite_true]

       cases ht:p.entry s x.1 with
       | zero=> rw [ht] at hp hq; grind
       | succ n=>
         cases n with
         | zero=> rw [ht] at hp hq; grind
         | succ n=>
           rw [ht] at hp hq
           have hs : 2 ≤ p.entry s x.1:=by omega
           have hu:= h.unique hc he hs x.2 ((walled _).1 ha).2 _ _ hp hq
           have hx: z.1=y.1:=by have h1:= (h.kite hc hs).1; have h2:=(h.kite he hs).1; grind
           apply Prod.ext hx
           grind
    projected:=by
       rintro x y z ⟨ha,hb,hc,hp⟩ ⟨hz,_,he,hq⟩ e
       apply Prod.ext e; rw [e] at hq
       cases ht:p.entry s x.1 with
       | zero=> rw [ht] at hp hq; grind
       | succ n=>
         cases n with
         | zero=> rw [ht] at hp hq; grind
         | succ n=>
           rw [ht] at hp hq
           have hs : 2 ≤ p.entry s x.1:=by omega
           have h1:=((h.kite hc hs).2 x.2 ((walled _).1 ha).2 true).2 _ hp
           have h2:=((h.kite hc hs).2 z.2 ((walled _).1 hz).2 true).2 _ hq
           grind

children.informal: For a cursor \(c\) in the cursor set, the tree's probe in direction \(b\) at \((v,c)\) with label \(i\) equals the local query \(\text{lit}_b((v,i),c)\) paired with \(i\).
children.header:
lemma auth (b:Bool) {v c:ℕ} (hc:c∈s.cursor) (i:ℕ) :
   h.twig.tree.probe b (v,c) i = (p.lit s b (v,i) c).map (fun j=>(i,j)):=by

children.informal: For every \(w\), the probe returns \(w\) iff the local query returns \(w\).
children.header:
have he(w:Dot): h.twig.tree.probe b (v,c) i=some w ↔
                (p.lit s b (v,i) c).map (fun j=>(i,j))=some w:=by

children.informal: Split \(w=(w_1,e)\) and the direction \(b\).
children.code:
rcases w with ⟨w,e⟩
      cases b

children.informal: For predecessor probes, reduce to the edge relation and split on whether \(w_1=i\).
Rewrite the predecessor probe as an edge into \((v,c)\) with label \(i\).
children.code:
· rw [h.twig.probeD]
        by_cases hk:w=i

children.informal: If \(w_1=i\), the edge \((i,e)\to(v,c)\) holds iff the backward local query returns \(e\).
children.code: · subst w; change p.Hill s (i,e) (v,c) ∧ _ ↔ _; rw [h.hover hc]; simp

children.informal: If \(w_1\ne i\), both sides are false.
children.code: simp [hk,Ne.symm hk]

children.informal: For successor probes, reduce to the edge relation and split on whether \(w_1=i\).
Rewrite the successor probe as an edge out of \((v,c)\) to label \(i\).
children.code:
· rw [h.twig.probeU]
        by_cases hk:w=i

children.informal: If \(w_1=i\), the edge \((v,c)\to(i,e)\) holds iff the forward local query returns \(e\).
children.code: · subst w; change p.Hill s (v,c) (i,e) ∧ _ ↔ _; rw [h.alive hc]; simp

children.informal: If \(w_1\ne i\), both sides are false.
children.code: simp [hk,Ne.symm hk]

children.informal: Two optional values with the same \(\text{some}\) members are equal.
children.code:
generalize h1:h.twig.tree.probe b (v,c) i=w at *
   generalize h2:(p.lit s b (v,i) c).map (fun j=>(i,j))=z at *
   cases w with
   | none=> cases z with
            | none=>rfl
            | some a=> have := he a; simp_all
   | some a=>
     exact ((he a).1 rfl).symm

children.informal: In a finite tree with root \(S\), the marked contour positions of the root component form a duplicate-free list starting at \((S,0)\), visited in order by the forward contour step and in reverse order by the backward step.
children.note: streak gives mutually inverse next-mark and previous-mark walks on the contour of the root component, with marks including the root sentinel \((S,0)\), using only the local steps \(\text{roll}\) and \(\text{fold}\) shown inverse in forward.
children.collapsedCode:
-- Lemma 11.5 (Inverse contour)
lemma streak {S} (hs:S∈g.V) (hh:g.up S=none) (m:Gem→Bool) (hm:m (S,0)=true) :
    ∃ l: List Gem, ((S,0)::l).Nodup ∧
       (∀ a,a∈(S,0)::l ↔ g.nest S a ∧ m a=true) ∧
       Stripe (Flare (march g true) m) (S,0) l (S,0) ∧
       Stripe (Flare (march g false) m) (S,0) l.reverse (S,0) := …

lemma forward {x} (h:g.live x) : g.live (g.roll x) ∧ g.fold (g.roll x)=x := …

children.informal: If \(S\in V\) is a root and \(m(S,0)=\text{true}\), there is a list \(l\) with \((S,0)::l\) duplicate-free, its members exactly the marked contour positions of the component of \(S\), linked from \((S,0)\) back to \((S,0)\) by forward contour steps between consecutive marks, and with \(l\) reversed linked by backward steps.
children.header:
lemma streak {S} (hs:S∈g.V) (hh:g.up S=none) (m:Gem→Bool) (hm:m (S,0)=true) :
    ∃ l: List Gem, ((S,0)::l).Nodup ∧
       (∀ a,a∈(S,0)::l ↔ g.nest S a ∧ m a=true) ∧
       Stripe (Flare (march g true) m) (S,0) l (S,0) ∧
       Stripe (Flare (march g false) m) (S,0) l.reverse (S,0):= by

children.informal: The root position \((S,0)\) lies in the component of \(S\).
children.code: have hr : g.nest S (S,0):=⟨⟨hs,Nat.zero_le _⟩,⟨0, Flight.node hs⟩⟩

children.informal: The forward contour orbit from \((S,0)\) is a cycle listing every position of the component exactly once.
children.code:
let v : Gem := (S,0)
   let p i j:=g.nest S i ∧ g.roll i=j
   obtain ⟨l,hl,he,h⟩:= Rope.cutpoint g.roll hr (fun a e=>g.rise hh e)
                     (fun a e=>g.orbit hh e) (g.whirl hs hh)

children.informal: Each step of this orbit is a forward contour move between live positions.
children.code:
have h1 : ∀ a b,p a b → march g true a b := by
      rintro a b ⟨e,rfl⟩; exact ⟨e.1,rfl,(g.forward e.1).1⟩

children.informal: Each forward move \(a\to b\) is a backward move \(b\to a\).
children.code:
have h2 : ∀ a b,march g true a b → march g false b a := by
      rintro a b ⟨e,rfl,h⟩; exact ⟨h,(g.forward e).2,e⟩

children.informal: Hence the reversed orbit is a chain of backward moves from \((S,0)\) to \((S,0)\).
children.code:
have hh : Stripe (march g false) v l.reverse v :=
         h.both (fun a b q=>h2 a b (h1 a b q))

children.informal: The orbit is a chain of forward moves from \((S,0)\) to \((S,0)\).
children.code: have hg : Stripe (march g true) v l v:= h.every h1

children.informal: Take the marked positions of the orbit as the list.
children.code: refine ⟨l.filter m,?_,fun i=>?_,stripes hg m hm,?_⟩

children.informal: Filtering keeps the list duplicate-free.
children.code: · simpa [hm] using hl.filter m

children.informal: Its members are exactly the marked positions of the component.
Use the description of the orbit's members.
children.code: · have hz:= he i

children.informal: Unfold membership in the filtered list and conclude.
children.code:
simp only [List.mem_cons,List.mem_filter]
     grind

children.informal: Filtering the reversed chain gives the backward chain between consecutive marks.
children.code: simpa using stripes hh m hm

children.informal: If \(x\) is a live contour position, then \(\text{roll}(x)\) is live and \(\text{fold}(\text{roll}(x))=x\).
children.header: lemma forward {x} (h:g.live x) : g.live (g.roll x) ∧ g.fold (g.roll x)=x := by

children.informal: Write \(x=(p,i)\) with \(p\in V\), \(i\le\text{rad}(p)\), and split on \(i<\text{rad}(p)\).
children.code:
rcases x with ⟨p,i⟩; obtain ⟨hz,ht⟩:=h
   change i≤g.broad p at ht
   change p∈g.V at hz
   by_cases hi:i<g.broad p

children.informal: If \(i<\text{rad}(p)\), stepping to the next child slot or descending to child \(i\) is undone by \(\text{fold}\).
children.code:
· cases he:g.kid p i with
     | none=> simp [live,roll,fold,hi,he,hz]
     | some y=>
       obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc⟩:=g.pairK p hz i he
       simp [live,roll,fold,hi,he,hb,hc,ha]

children.informal: If \(i=\text{rad}(p)\), returning to the parent (or the root wrap) is undone by \(\text{fold}\).
children.code:
cases he:g.up p with
   | none=> simp [live,roll,fold,hz,hi,he]; omega
   | some y=>
      obtain ⟨ha,hb,hc,hd⟩:=g.pairU p hz he
      change p.1<g.broad y at hc
      simp [live,roll,fold,hi,he,ha,hd]; omega

children.informal: On a root contour circuit with other marks \(l\), the program \(\text{dune}\) moves from the root to the \(i\)th mark when \(|l|\le k\) and \(1\le i\le|l|\), and the program \(\text{surf}\) moves from a mark back to the root with inverse port \(|a|+1\) when \(|l|\le k\), failing otherwise.
children.note: These are the capped paired motions of the lemma: the endpoint's incoming entries are the contour marks, the cap is \(k\), and the ports are positions \(1,\dots,k\) in the contour order.
children.collapsedCode:
-- Lemma 11.6 (Capped incoming ports)
lemma chose {s x l} (h:r.Circuit s x l) (k i:ℕ) (yes bad:Cog)
   {u} (hy: (l.length≤ k ∧ 0 < i ∧ i≤l.length) →
             ∃ a b v,l=a++v::b ∧ i=a.length+1 ∧
                               s.acts yes (s.tag v false) u)
   (hw: ¬ (l.length≤ k ∧ 0 < i ∧ i≤l.length) → s.acts bad (s.tag x false) u):
    s.acts (r.dune k i yes bad) (s.tag x false) u := …

lemma climbed {s x l} (h:r.Circuit s x l) (k:ℕ) (y:ℕ → Cog) (bad:Cog)
   {u a b i} (hs:l=a++i::b)
   (hy:l.length≤k → s.acts (y (a.length+1)) (s.tag x false) u)
   (hw:k< l.length → s.acts bad (s.tag i false) u) :
   s.acts (r.surf k y bad) (s.tag i false) u := …

children.informal: If the root \(x\) has contour circuit with marks \(l\), then \(\text{dune}(k,i,\text{yes},\text{bad})\) runs from \(x\) to \(u\), provided \(\text{yes}\) reaches \(u\) from the \(i\)th mark \(v\) (\(l=a\,v\,b\), \(i=|a|+1\)) when \(|l|\le k\) and \(0<i\le|l|\), and \(\text{bad}\) reaches \(u\) from \(x\) otherwise.
children.header:
lemma chose {s x l} (h:r.Circuit s x l) (k i:ℕ) (yes bad:Cog)
   {u} (hy: (l.length≤ k ∧ 0 < i ∧ i≤l.length) →
             ∃ a b v,l=a++v::b ∧ i=a.length+1 ∧
                               s.acts yes (s.tag v false) u)
   (hw: ¬ (l.length≤ k ∧ 0 < i ∧ i≤l.length) → s.acts bad (s.tag x false) u):
    s.acts (r.dune k i yes bad) (s.tag x false) u:= by

children.informal: Reduce to the counting traversal, whose continuation receives \(\min(|l|,k+1)\).
children.code:
apply r.attained h
   split

children.informal: Case \(|l|\le k\) and \(0<i\le|l|\).
Enter this case.
children.code: · next ht=>

children.informal: Walk \(i\) forward steps along the circuit to the \(i\)th mark and continue with \(\text{yes}\).
children.code:
obtain ⟨a,b,v,e,ht1,hp⟩:=hy (by omega)
     subst l; subst i
     exact follow (h.round.sever.1.every (fun y z h=>h.1)) hp

children.informal: Otherwise continue with \(\text{bad}\) from \(x\).
children.code: · next ht=> exact hw (by omega)

children.informal: If the root \(x\) has contour circuit with marks \(l=a\,i\,b\), then \(\text{surf}(k,y,\text{bad})\) runs from mark \(i\) to \(u\), provided \(y(|a|+1)\) reaches \(u\) from \(x\) when \(|l|\le k\), and \(\text{bad}\) reaches \(u\) from \(i\) when \(k<|l|\).
children.header:
lemma climbed {s x l} (h:r.Circuit s x l) (k:ℕ) (y:ℕ → Cog) (bad:Cog)
   {u a b i} (hs:l=a++i::b)
   (hy:l.length≤k → s.acts (y (a.length+1)) (s.tag x false) u)
   (hw:k< l.length → s.acts bad (s.tag i false) u) :
   s.acts (r.surf k y bad) (s.tag i false) u:= by

children.informal: Substitute \(l=a\,i\,b\).
children.code: subst l

children.informal: Split the circuit at mark \(i\) into a part before and after it.
children.code: have hh:= h.round.sever

children.informal: From \(i\), the circuit's remaining part reaches the root in \(|b|+1\) steps.
children.code: have ht:= Alley.ofStripe hh.2 h.init (h.others i (by simp)) (fun x h1=>h.others x (by simp [h1]))

children.informal: Walk forward to the root, counting \(|b|+1\) steps when at most \(k\).
children.code: apply r.sounded ht

children.informal: Case: the root is reached within the bound.
At the root, run the counting traversal and split on \(|l|\le k\).
children.code:
· intro hb
     apply r.attained h
     simp only [List.length_append,List.length_cons]
     split

children.informal: Subcase \(|l|\le k\).
Enter this subcase.
children.code: · next hl=>

children.informal: Here \(|l|\le k\).
children.code: have h1: (a++i::b).length ≤ k:=by simp; omega

children.informal: So \(y(|a|+1)\) reaches \(u\) from \(x\).
children.code: have hp:=hy h1

children.informal: It remains to match the computed index with \(|a|+1\).
children.code: convert hp using 1
have hz : min (a.length+(b.length+1)) (k+1)+1-(b.length+1)=a.length+1:= by omega

children.informal: Substitute this index.
children.code: rw [hz]

children.informal: Subcase \(k<|l|\).
Enter this subcase.
children.code: · next hl=>

children.informal: Here \(k<|l|\).
children.code: have he:k < (a++i::b).length:=by simp; omega

children.informal: Walking back \(|b|+1\) steps from the root returns to \(i\), where \(\text{bad}\) reaches \(u\).
children.code:
have hu:=follow (hh.2.both (w:=fun a b=>s.acts r.back (s.tag a false) (s.tag b false))
                                      (fun y z h=>h.2)) (hw he)

children.informal: Conclude this subcase.
children.code: simpa using hu

children.informal: If the root is not reached within the bound, then \(k<|l|\) and \(\text{bad}\) runs from \(i\).
children.code: intro hb; apply hw; simp; omega

children.informal: The track program computes the place-\(t\) digit of the incoming score rank with a raw certificate at level \((W(u),t)\) that restores the catalyst word, and these digits approximate the \(k\)th-largest incoming score value within \(2\) at every place \(t\le H\).
children.note: scoreRank is the rank (\(k\)th largest, zero padded) of the incoming scores and digit certifies its digit computation at clock \(t\) with bounded overshoot, matching the lemma's exact redundant digits and record bound.
children.collapsedCode:
-- Lemma 11.7 (Incoming score rank)
lemma digit {t}(ht:t ≤ v.H){x}(hx:x∈e.D.P){b}(hb:e.D.r.proper b):
       Lot.Mane e.D.l v.Bcost ⟨e.D.W e.u,t⟩ 1 (e.Q t) (trackG e.p e.R e.D.s e.A v.topk v.k) (0,glove b x)
                        (codeQ (v.scoreTape x t),glove b x) := …

lemma estimated (c:ℕ):Checked (v.scoreTape c) (v.scoreRank c) v.H := …

children.informal: For \(t\le H\), \(x\in P\) and a proper catalyst \(b\), the track program runs from \((0,\text{glove}(b,x))\) to \((\text{code}(\text{scoreTape}_x(t)),\text{glove}(b,x))\) with a raw certificate of coefficient \(\text{Bcost}\), level \((W(u),t)\) and gap \(1\).
children.header:
lemma digit {t}(ht:t ≤ v.H){x}(hx:x∈e.D.P){b}(hb:e.D.r.proper b):
       Lot.Mane e.D.l v.Bcost ⟨e.D.W e.u,t⟩ 1 (e.Q t) (trackG e.p e.R e.D.s e.A v.topk v.k) (0,glove b x)
                        (codeQ (v.scoreTape x t),glove b x):=by

children.informal: Fix the contour invocation \(q\) at precision \(t\) and catalyst \(b\).
children.code:
classical
   let q:=e.q t b

children.informal: It has \(t+1\) steps, its circuits are well formed, and it is tidy.
children.code: have h1:q.H=t+1:=h.crest t ht; have h2:=h.gears ht hb; have hp:q.Tidy:=(h.p t ht).lit h.h b hb

children.informal: Each threshold label \(2^t+i\) with \(i\le 2^t\) has admissible size.
children.code: have hs(i:ℕ)(hi:i ≤ (2:ℕ)^t):q.Stringent (2^t+i):=stringentQ hp h1 hi

children.informal: For each threshold \(i\le 2^t\) there is a contour list of incoming entries.
children.header: have he(i:ℕ):∃ l,i ≤ (2:ℕ)^t→q.Wheel hp e.fav (2^t+i) x l:=by

children.informal: Split on \(i\le 2^t\).
children.code: by_cases hk:i ≤ (2:ℕ)^t

children.informal: If so, the contour traversal supplies such a list.
children.code: · obtain ⟨l,h⟩:=q.beat hp h2 (hs i hk) hx; exact ⟨l,fun _=>h⟩

children.informal: Otherwise take the empty list.
children.code: exact ⟨[],fun h=> (hk h).elim⟩

children.informal: Choose these lists and assemble the rank traversal data with the score digits and the cap \(k\).
children.code:
choose l hl using he
   let f:Isle:=⟨q,e.fav,l,x,S e x,v.teaN t,v.topk,v.k⟩

children.informal: Its offset equals \(2^t\).
children.code: have hc:f.P=(2:ℕ)^t:= h.lit t ht

children.informal: The traversal data are well formed.
children.header: have hk:f.Wrap hp:=by

children.informal: Check the required fields one by one.
children.code: refine ⟨hx,fun i hi=>?_,fun i hi=> by change q.Stringent (f.P+i); rw [hc]; exact hs i (hi.trans hc.le),fun i hi hz=>?_ ,fun i hi=>?_⟩

children.informal: Each threshold has its contour list.
children.code:
· change q.Wheel hp e.fav (f.P+i) x (l i)
         rw [hc]; exact hl i (hi.trans hc.le)

children.informal: Each list length equals the number of incoming digits equal to that threshold.
children.code: · exact h.counted ht hx (hi.trans hc.le) (hl i (hi.trans hc.le))

children.informal: The thresholds stay within the bound.
children.code: exact le_trans (min_le_left ..) hc.ge

children.informal: The invocation's level is \((W(u),t)\).
children.code: have hb0:q.B=⟨e.D.W e.u,t⟩:= e.D.s.born ..

children.informal: Rewrite the level accordingly.
children.code: rw [← hb0]

children.informal: The coefficient \(\text{Bcost}\) equals the traversal's cost.
children.code: have hp0 : v.Bcost=f.pay:=by unfold Bcost Isle.pay Isle.pay1 Isle.speed; change _=e.A*(2*e.A+40)+3*(v.k+50)+3*(v.k+50); omega

children.informal: The traversal computes \(\text{code}(\text{rank}_k)\) with this certificate.
children.code: rw [hp0]; exact hk.cash

children.informal: The score tape is a checked approximation: \(|\text{scoreRank}(c)|\le1\) and \(|\text{scoreTape}_c(t)-2^t\,\text{scoreRank}(c)|\le2\) for all \(t\le H\), where \(\text{scoreRank}(c)\) is the \(k\)th-largest incoming score.
children.header: lemma estimated (c:ℕ):Checked (v.scoreTape c) (v.scoreRank c) v.H:=by

children.informal: Let \(X\) be the set of incoming entries of \(c\).
children.code: let X:=S e c

children.informal: Each entry of \(X\) has a nonnegative score \(V_0(i)\) with checked digits up to \(H\).
children.code:
have hk(i:ℕ)(hi:i∈X):0  ≤  v.V0 i∧Checked
                            (v.w (token i).1 (token i).2) (v.V0 i) v.H :=
          h.safe _ ((unsealed (e := e)) hi).2.1 _ ((unsealed (e := e)) hi).1

children.informal: Hence the rank satisfies \(|\text{scoreRank}(c)|\le1\).
children.code:
have hp: |v.scoreRank c| ≤ 1:= show |v.scoreRank c|  ≤  1 from by
       rw [abs_of_nonneg (rank_nn ..)]; exact rank_le (by norm_num) (fun i hi=>(abs_le.1 (hk i hi).2.1).2)

children.informal: It remains to bound the error at each \(t\le H\).
children.code: refine ⟨hp,fun t ht=>?_⟩

children.informal: Since rank is \(1\)-Lipschitz in the sup norm and each digit is within \(2\) of \(2^t V_0(i)\), the integer rank is within \(2\) of \(2^t\,\text{scoreRank}(c)\).
children.code:
have he : |((rankN X (v.teaN t) v.k):ℝ)- 2^t*scoreRank v c| ≤ 2:=by
       rw [rankN_v,scoreRank,← scaled_rank (by positivity)]; apply rank_lip (by norm_num)
       intro i hi; obtain ⟨h1,h2,h3⟩:=hk i hi
       exact tag_est h1 ⟨h2,fun l hl=> h3 l (hl.trans ht)⟩

children.informal: This is the claimed bound for \(\text{scoreTape}_c(t)\).
children.code: unfold scoreTape; push_cast; exact he

children.informal: A visit program consisting of a selection query, a forward paired probe, an optional single delegation or local label map, and a backward probe has a raw certificate with \(O(d)\) record at level \((w,0)\).
children.note: The docstring of Vase describes a visit whose single optional subterminal path is delegated, with pure actions compiled at leaves, and arrives certifies exactly this ordered form.
children.collapsedCode:
-- Lemma 11.8 (Ordered terminal paths and excursions)
lemma arrives {s:Den} (h:s.good){x y h0 w z i:ℕ} (ht:s.bit h0 ) (hb:s.bit i)
   (hs:s.meets v.start (0,x ) (h0,x) ) (he:h0 ≠0)
   (hf:∀ b,s.pull ((v.probe b).f s.l.x (s.q,h0)))
   (hp:s.atCall ((v.probe true).f s.l.x (s.q,h0)) x (1,y))
   (hg:s.atCall ((v.probe false).f s.l.x (s.q,h0)) z (1,w))
   (hE:v.dives.f s.l.x (s.q,h0)=true →
                s.pull (v.bud.f s.l.x (s.q,h0)) ∧ s.atCall (v.bud.f s.l.x (s.q,h0)) y (i,z))
   (hD:v.dives.f s.l.x (s.q,h0)=false → v.next.f s.l.x (s.q,h0,y)=(i,z)):
    s.meets v.play (0,x) (i,w) := …

children.informal: If \(k\ge4\), \(1\le d\le w\), the selection returns \(h_0\ne0\), the records \(h_0,i\) have \(\ell\le kd\), the forward probe moves \(x\) to \(y\), then either the delegation (when chosen) or the local map gives \((i,z)\) from \(y\), and the backward probe moves \(z\) to \(w\), with all calls affordable, then \(\text{play}\) runs from \((0,x)\) to \((i,w)\) with a certificate of coefficient \(10k\) at level \((w,0)\) and gap \(d\).
children.header:
lemma arrives {s:Den} (h:s.good){x y h0 w z i:ℕ} (ht:s.bit h0 ) (hb:s.bit i)
   (hs:s.meets v.start (0,x ) (h0,x) ) (he:h0 ≠0)
   (hf:∀ b,s.pull ((v.probe b).f s.l.x (s.q,h0)))
   (hp:s.atCall ((v.probe true).f s.l.x (s.q,h0)) x (1,y))
   (hg:s.atCall ((v.probe false).f s.l.x (s.q,h0)) z (1,w))
   (hE:v.dives.f s.l.x (s.q,h0)=true →
                s.pull (v.bud.f s.l.x (s.q,h0)) ∧ s.atCall (v.bud.f s.l.x (s.q,h0)) y (i,z))
   (hD:v.dives.f s.l.x (s.q,h0)=false → v.next.f s.l.x (s.q,h0,y)=(i,z)):
    s.meets v.play (0,x) (i,w):=by
